argumentation_roles.lesson: Start with representative raw waveforms, then show a small number of interpretable shape/frequency features. Perfect separability should be stress-tested across held-out operating regimes, not merely visualized.
Use aligned panels for baseline and each added interaction, but pair them with leave-condition-out residual/error distributions; fitted surfaces alone only show calibration.
The frequency-stratified plot is more informative than a global heatmap because it reveals effect reversal. Prefer adjusted marginal effects over raw means when continuous covariates vary.
A staged ablation table is strong evidence when every stage uses the identical split and final code path. Radar charts should not replace direct error tables and uncertainty across splits.
Show a Pareto/scalarization-normalization audit, categorical feasibility and repeated-run distributions. One best row is insufficient when stochastic optimizers and mixed categories are involved.
